subtitle: Lightweight ShellClash control center
notInstalled: No compatible ShellClash / ShellCrash installation found
dashboardNoSecret: The dashboard has no access secret. Use it only on a trusted LAN.
proxyModeTip: Switch the Clash runtime mode without restarting the service.
trafficModeTip: Select the transparent proxy implementation used by ShellCrash.
dnsModeTip: Switching to fake-ip disables incompatible China IPv4/IPv6 bypass rules.
restartAfterApply: A running service is restarted once to load the new configuration.
ipCheckTip: Check the router egress and local mixed proxy port public IPv4 addresses.
confirmStop: Stopping interrupts proxy connections for LAN clients. Continue?
confirmRestart: Proxy connections are briefly interrupted during restart. Continue?
confirmApplyRestart: Applying these modes restarts the running service. Continue?
invalidResponse: The server returned an invalid response
permissionMissing: Required plugin permissions are missing. Grant them in Framework Settings.
ipv6ProxyTip: Enable ShellCrash transparent proxy interception for IPv6.
quicProxyTip: When off, UDP 443/8443 is blocked to reduce QUIC bypass; when on, the proxy core may handle it.
uploadConfigTip: Clash YAML files up to 2 MiB are accepted and are not activated automatically.
importConfigTip: Only public HTTPS URLs are accepted. The URL is not returned in status or logs.
profileValidationTip: Uploads get basic name, size, and structure checks; the proxy core validates them before switching, and a running service is restarted.
importFieldsRequired: Enter an HTTPS URL and a configuration name ending in .yaml or .yml.
confirmSwitchRestart: Switching configuration restarts the running service. Continue?
ipCheckFailed: All egress IP services are unavailable.
